parent: BWX Technologies, Inc. (1720 Mt. Athos Road, Lynchburg, Virginia; NYSE: BWXT)
notes: The grantee, BWXT Government Group Inc. of Barberton, is the nuclear operations arm of BWX Technologies, Inc., whose 10-K for the 2020 grant year states that at December 31, 2020 it employed about 6,700 persons worldwide, 5,400 in the United States and 1,300 in Canada. SEC records give the parent's business address as Lynchburg, Virginia, so the Barberton plant does not make the group Ohio-headquartered.

parent: EVE Energy Co., Ltd. (No. 38 Huifeng 7th Road, Zhongkai Hi-Tech Zone, Huizhou, Guangdong, China; Shenzhen ChiNext code 300014)
notes: EVE's own About page says the company was established in 2001, listed on the Shenzhen ChiNext board in 2009, and has more than 30,000 staff worldwide, and its contact address is in Huizhou, Guangdong. The Lewis Center grantee, Eve Energy North America Corporation, is the group's U.S. research arm, with only 8 jobs retained on JobsOhio's own project report, so the size and home country follow the listed Chinese parent.

company: Amcor plc (Amcor Limited at time of grant)
parent: Amcor Limited (incorporated in Victoria, Australia and listed on the ASX in the grant year; global management office in Zurich, Switzerland)
notes: The Amcor-Bemis merger registration statement describes Amcor's two segments as of June 30, 2018: about 26,000 employees and 135 plants in 37 countries in Flexibles, and about 7,000 employees at 60 plants in 12 countries in Rigid Plastics, which is the segment the Bellevue grantee Amcor Rigid Plastics USA, LLC belongs to. The same filing places the chief executive and the board's meetings in Zurich during the 2017 grant year, before the 2019 Bemis merger and the move to Jersey, so the parent was well above 500 and not Ohio-based.

parent: Interstate Chemical Company, Inc. (2797 Freedland Road, Hermitage, Pennsylvania; privately held, founded 1968 by Albert R. Puntureri)
notes: JobsOhio's own success story opens by calling Alpont LLC a Pennsylvania-based subsidiary of Interstate Chemical Company, and Interstate Chemical's own site lists Alpont Transportation LLC among its services and gives corporate headquarters in Hermitage, Pennsylvania, so the Oregon, Ohio methanol and sodium methylate plant is a Pennsylvania company's plant. Neither company publishes a headcount; the Small call is an inference from a privately held chemical distributor with 16 terminals and a fleet of about 200 trucks and trailers.

company: GG Brands Company LLC (The Gorilla Glue Company)
parent: GG Brands Company LLC / The Gorilla Glue Company, Cincinnati, Ohio (family owned; no outside parent)
notes: The company's own About page says The Gorilla Glue Company is based in Cincinnati, Ohio, and no filing or site text names a parent above GG Brands Company LLC, the Ohio entity that sponsors the retirement plan. JobsOhio's project report counts 529 jobs retained at the Ohio site in the 2022 grant year, which on its own is above the 500 line before the company's other locations are added, and Form 5500 participants rose from 208 in 2015 to 521 in 2019; no source states a worldwide headcount, so the figure is a band.

parent: Aurora Plastics, LLC (Aurora Material Solutions), 9280 Jefferson Street, Streetsboro, Ohio; Nautic Partners is the private equity owner, not the parent
notes: The August 2021 sale announcement says Aurora Plastics was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Streetsboro, Ohio, and Aurora's own About page gives the same Streetsboro address as its corporate and technical center. A private equity fund is not the parent, so the operating group Aurora Material Solutions is, and its home state is Ohio rather than Nautic's Rhode Island. Six plants by September 2022, 229 Form 5500 participants in 2023 and 68 jobs retained in Streetsboro all point below 500; no published headcount, so the range is an estimate.

parent: Steelite International Limited, Orme Street, Burslem, Stoke-on-Trent, England (Companies House no. 01697123)
notes: Steelite International Limited's consolidated accounts to 31 December 2023, filed at Companies House, report a monthly average of 916 persons employed by the group in 2023 and 808 in 2022, split 220 management and administration and 696 production. The registered office is Orme Street, Burslem, Stoke-on-Trent, and the grantee Steelite International USA Inc. of New Castle, Pennsylvania is the group's Americas arm, so the 2024 grant year parent is well above 500 and not Ohio-based.

parent: Borgers SE & Co. KGaA, Borgersstrasse 2-10, 46397 Bocholt, Germany (family owned)
notes: The group's own turnover-and-staff page, captured in 2019, charts group employees at 7,249 in 2016, 7,610 in 2017 and 7,097 in 2018, and gives the address as Borgersstrasse 2-10, Bocholt, Germany with sites in Germany, Belgium, England, Sweden, Spain, the Czech Republic, China and the United States. Borgers Ohio, Inc. in Norwalk was that group's U.S. plant through the 2016, 2017 and 2020 grant years; Autoneum of Switzerland only agreed to buy the Borgers automotive business in January 2023, after the grant years, so the parent for those years is the German group.
